jobs.title: Clinical Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.why: Exceptionally close to Kevin’s healthcare operations work: Intake/Care Operations, playbook execution, training for launches, KPI dashboards, bottleneck identification, cross-functional coordination, and workflow automation.
jobs.gap: Requires 4–5 years in Business Operations, Strategy, or Consulting and strong startup operating experience; Kevin should emphasize hands-on execution and measurable workflow improvements.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Strong healthcare implementation fit spanning practice onboarding, launch timelines, clinical/implementation workstreams, training materials, patient-data intake, vendor relationships, and ongoing operating relationships.
jobs.gap: Nephrology/chronic-care management, EHR data workflows, and secure patient-data transfer are preferred domain gaps.

jobs.title: Digital Program Manager
jobs.why: Realistic 3–6 year experience band with healthcare-tech implementations, onboarding, milestone tracking, requirements, reporting, documentation, process improvement, and cross-functional delivery.
jobs.gap: Healthcare-data/interoperability depth and analytics tooling are the main gaps. SQL should be presented only as foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Enterprise Implementation Manager
jobs.why: Healthcare SaaS role combining enterprise onboarding, project management, client operations, documentation, data-connector implementations, cross-functional coordination, and continuous process improvement.
jobs.gap: Arcadia asks for healthcare population-health/value-based-care depth plus claims/clinical data integration and longer-term account ownership.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Accessible 2+ year threshold and strong fit for cross-functional execution, system migrations, structured intake/project processes, documentation, workflow automation, dependencies, and operational problem solving.
jobs.gap: Not healthcare-focused, and the role is hybrid in NYC. Technical concepts and data workflows matter, but SQL is only a nice-to-have conceptual skill here.
